hero.titleHtml:
Where the sea touches stone
and time slows down.
hero.manifesto: A unique coastal sanctuary in Iriri where guests savor authentic capixaba gastronomy, unwind to the rhythm of the tides, and contemplate the boundless ocean horizon.
hero.directRate: Official Direct Rate • Traditional Capixaba Breakfast Included
hero.imgAlt: Granite coastal rocks and crystal-blue sea in Iriri

concept.title: Dine, unwind, and contemplate the sea of Iriri.
concept.p1: Recanto da Pedra was born from the organic harmony between Iriri’s mineral cliffs and the pristine waters of Costa Azul. We are more than an inn: we are an oceanfront haven with a capixaba soul that invites you to slow down, breathe the ocean breeze, and cherish life’s most genuine pleasures.
concept.p2: Architecture integrated into the rocky terrain, fine hardwood ocean decks, coastal flora, and a kitchen that honors the artisanal clay pot traditions of Goiabeiras with fresh fish and seafood sourced daily from our local coastline.
concept.pillar1Desc: Rooted and contemporary capixaba cuisine crafted with fresh local ingredients overlooking the ocean.
concept.pillar2Desc: Breezy suites, pure cotton linens, and the soothing murmur of breaking waves.
concept.pillar3Desc: Golden sunrises over the granite cliffs and the deep blue expanse of Iriri bay.
concept.badgeHtml: Privacy & Serenity: Only a select collection of suites to ensure absolute peace.

suites.title: Havens facing the azure horizon
suites.description: Each space is crafted to celebrate coastal sunlight, organic textures, natural woods, and an unobstructed view of Iriri's granite boulders and sea.

suite1.name: Suíte Costa Azul
suite1.desc: Expansive private oceanfront balcony, King Size bed, horizon-view walk-in shower, and 400-thread-count linens.

suite2.name: Suíte Mirante da Pedra
suite2.desc: Perched directly above the granite coastline with floor-to-ceiling glass. Savor breathtaking sunsets straight from your soaking tub.

suite3.name: Bangalô das Enseadas
suite3.desc: Freestanding bungalow with private timber deck, sun terrace with loungers, and secluded private access to the ocean rocks.

gastronomy.title: Flavors born from the capixaba sea and soil
gastronomy.quote: “Moqueca is capixaba; everything else is just fish stew.” Here at Recanto da Pedra, this Brazilian tradition comes to life in handmade clay pots, pure annatto oil, fresh cilantro, and noble fish landed daily in Iriri and Anchieta.
gastronomy.dish1Title: Moqueca Capixaba of Grouper & Jumbo Shrimp
gastronomy.dish1Desc: Slow-simmered in artisanal clay cookware, served with velvety fish broth reduction (pirão) and fresh coconut rice.
gastronomy.dish2Desc: Historic coastal recipe blending shredded crab, Atlantic salt cod, wild prawns, and fresh heart of palm.
gastronomy.dish3Desc: Refreshing craft cocktails infused with coastal fruits, artisanal capixaba cachaça, and subtle spices.
gastronomy.btnReserveTable: Reserve a Table at the Restaurant
gastronomy.captionHall: Dining room with coastal rock views
gastronomy.imgAltMoqueca: Traditional Capixaba Moqueca in artisanal clay pot

experiences.title: The Charm of Costa Azul
experiences.description: Iriri is fondly celebrated as the most charming beach destination in Espírito Santo. From calm, warm coves to wind-sculpted granite headlands, embrace every nuance.
experiences.exp1Desc: Peaceful swimming and snorkeling among crystal reefs and boulders right in front of Recanto.
experiences.exp1ImgAlt: Natural tide pools on the granite shore of Iriri
experiences.exp2Desc: Artisanal breads, homemade cakes, regional farm cheeses, and fresh tropical fruit served oceanfront.
experiences.exp2ImgAlt: Artisanal outdoor breakfast overlooking the ocean
experiences.exp3Desc: The daily evening spectacle as golden twilight tones illuminate Iriri’s granite formations.
experiences.exp4Desc: Cruise along the serene coves of Areia Preta, Costa Azul, Namorados, and Santa Helena.
experiences.exp4ImgAlt: Scenic boat tours along Anchieta coves

reviews.title: Words from Our Guests
reviews.rev1Quote: “Waking up to waves breaking against the rocks and having an impeccable breakfast overlooking Costa Azul is priceless. The moqueca served in their restaurant is easily one of the finest in Espírito Santo.”
reviews.rev2Quote: “The attention to aesthetics and acoustic tranquility is outstanding. An inn that truly respects nature while delivering boutique comfort of the highest order in Brazil.”
reviews.rev3Quote: “A perfect retreat for couples looking to genuinely disconnect. Sharing a fine wine on the ocean deck as dusk settles over the rocks is unforgettable.”
